test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: D, E, F, G, L, M and N are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. N sits third to the left of M. L sits second to the left of G. M is an immediate neighbour of both E and L. D is not an immediate neighbour of N. How many people sit between F and L when counted from the right of F?
solution:
Given D, E, F, G, L, M and N are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

N sits third to the left of M.

M is an immediate neighbour of both E and L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05380b8a96fd318afde7c16843d44e4df7a189151120f5bd2a3bb09f53c5efd8.png] 

D is not an immediate neighbour of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/950510dfed9d09819145427192e8e1d17282543aeceb8f15801f438ccec9454d.png] 

L sits second to the left of G.

And F sits at remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8a5022606d93cf88bb3aa77deacaa6626299e78da92ea134790f793bb43ba24.png] 

Two people sit between F and L when counted from the right of F.

Hence the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
